finding.original_statement: Two representatives of one fiber define competing transition laws; their maximal total-variation distance is delta.
finding.supported_defect: No operation distribution, visibility of the chosen operation, or corresponding conditional kernel is fixed. For a fixed deterministic translation the representative laws are Dirac measures and their TV distance is binary. Averaging uniformly over all translations with the operation hidden instead makes the next state uniform for every starting point, hence gives zero defect for every partition. These two interpretations do not support the same proposed graded/destruction diagnostic. The finite O(N*K*t) table also does not certify arbitrarily many conditioned histories without a sufficient-state or compact-certificate argument.
finding.smallest_additive_correction: Freeze the randomized transition kernel and observable operation label, the information conditioned on, and the scope of histories. Distinguish a per-operation defect from a mixture defect. Either give a finite sufficient-state bound or leave complete-history certification and its cost as a prerequisite.
finding.clearing_check: A paper audit must derive the fixed-operation and hidden-uniform-mixture boundaries under the declared definition, explain what happens when all translations are added, and show which statistic the matched partitions can actually vary.
finding.scope_limit: Proposal specification review only; the proposed check was not executed and no mathematical lane is closed.

finding.original_statement: the second factorial moment counts pairs of distinct tuple-orbits with the same public sum
finding.supported_defect: A diagonal automorphism sends a tuple summing to R to one summing to phi(R), so a fixed nonzero-target fiber is generally not stable under the full action. The proposal does not say whether it quotients the target jointly, restricts to the target stabilizer, or counts representative-target incidences. Separately, distinct tuple orbits need not be independent relation rows; the cost input eta=independent-orbits/raw-tuples lacks that distinction.
finding.smallest_additive_correction: Define the tuple-target incidence space and group action and derive stabilizer weights there. Use distinct-orbit yield for the certified quantity; reserve informative rank yield for a separately justified conditional probability or an additional certificate.
finding.clearing_check: For one formal target moved by an allowed automorphism, track the transformed tuple and target and show the statistic is representative independent. The duplicated-orbit control must leave distinct yield unchanged; an additional same-rank control must prevent promotion from distinctness to rank gain.
finding.scope_limit: Proposal specification review only; the proposed check was not executed and no mathematical lane is closed.

slots.problem_bucket: supersingular distribution heuristic and tails

finding.finding: The design explicitly uses a finite product-Bernoulli generating function, while the baseline asserts exact second factorial moment lambda squared. That identity is Poisson-style; for independent Bernoulli marks the finite correction sum of squared probabilities remains. Comparing to squared mean can therefore label a null effect as clustering.
finding.required_revision: Choose a finite Bernoulli or Poisson/limiting null and state its exact moment normalization. Align H1, the reported ratio and factor-two rejection rule to that same null; require the exact null to pass before norm-value comparisons.
finding.scope_limit: Static inconsistency between stated definitions. No norm form, finite fixture or probability calculation was executed.

finding.original_statement: All local weights one and independent marks recover factorial moment lambda squared.
finding.supported_defect: For a finite sum of independent Bernoulli marks with probabilities p_i and mean lambda, E[S(S-1)]=lambda^2-sum_i p_i^2. The exact lambda^2 identity belongs to a Poisson count; the finite Bernoulli-to-Poisson approximation needs its error bounded. A deterministic norm multiset also needs a declared random marking/form ensemble to interpret its expectations.
finding.smallest_additive_correction: Replace the finite baseline by its correct Bernoulli identity and align the dependence normalization with it, or explicitly adopt a Poisson reference with an approximation error. Freeze the probability space, distinguishing deterministic norm entries, residue weights and random marks.
finding.clearing_check: Derive the first two derivatives of the finite product generating polynomial and retain the diagonal correction. Any Poisson normalization must include a bound on the omitted sum of squared probabilities.
finding.scope_limit: Proposal specification review only; the proposed check was not executed and no mathematical lane is closed.

slots.problem_bucket: isogeny representation and reduction-interface proof obligations

finding.original_statement: Represent a morphism by its source, target and transition isomorphisms under the field automorphisms, retaining the cocycle defect on overlaps.
finding.supported_defect: Valid descent cocycles for source and target certify object descent, but the supplied morphism must also commute with their Galois descent maps. The proposed necessary-and-sufficient field certificate and C_iso cost do not explicitly state or price this morphism compatibility equation. This is a specification gap; it does not refute a full descent theorem with that equation included.
finding.smallest_additive_correction: List object cocycle checks and the separate equivariance square for each supplied morphism. Include exact morphism-equality/representation costs in C_iso by definition or add a separate term. Otherwise limit the output to compatibility of object descent data.
finding.clearing_check: Hold valid source/target cocycles fixed and compare a morphism satisfying the square with one violating it. The latter must be rejected even though both endpoint cocycles vanish.
finding.scope_limit: Proposal specification review only; the proposed check was not executed and no mathematical lane is closed.

slots.problem_bucket: shared curve-parameter certificate composition

finding.original_statement: O(k log p) group operations plus big-integer CRT for k supplied witnesses
finding.supported_defect: For a general composite point-order claim, an annihilation relation alone is insufficient to certify the asserted order; factor-specific nonzero checks must be included. O(k log p) is coherent if k counts the verified prime-order/factor components, but the proposal currently calls k supplied witnesses and also permits general divisors and lcm composition. Charging primality certificates separately does not define the number of group checks.
finding.smallest_additive_correction: Define k as the total number of required prime-factor order checks, or restrict witness units to explicitly certified prime/prime-power components. If k instead counts points with arbitrary composite claimed orders, include their factor-check count and witness bytes in the bound.
finding.clearing_check: A symbolic cost audit with fixed raw point count and varying numbers of distinct certified prime factors must preserve the stated operation bound and reject an annihilation-only claim whose order divisor is unsupported.
finding.scope_limit: Proposal specification review only; the proposed check was not executed and no mathematical lane is closed.

slots.problem_bucket: complete-formula and input-domain proof obligations

finding.finding: The mechanism asks that the union of chart base loci avoid the permitted domain, while the claim says every pair is covered by at least one chart and elsewhere asks for the common base locus. The union condition would demand every chart work everywhere and can reject the intended jointly complete cover.
finding.required_revision: Use the common intersection of chart failure loci for the stated forall-pair/exists-chart claim. Add an explicit positive control whose charts are each incomplete but collectively cover the domain, alongside the incomplete single-chart control.
finding.scope_limit: Internal specification consistency only; no polynomial identity or curve arithmetic verified.

finding.original_statement: An algebraic identity proving that the union of base loci has empty intersection with the permitted domain gives a completeness certificate.
finding.supported_defect: Joint chart coverage requires no point to lie in every chart's base locus: the common intersection of base loci must miss the domain. Requiring their union to miss it instead requires every chart to be individually defined everywhere and contradicts the stated two-chart goal. The later proof obligation correctly says empty common base locus.
finding.smallest_additive_correction: Replace union by intersection/common base locus. Specify the admitted rational or geometric input domain and keep group-law correctness on defined charts as a separate obligation from coverage.
finding.clearing_check: Two complementary incomplete charts with nonempty individual base loci and empty common base locus must pass the joint coverage condition; a remaining common omitted identity component must fail.
finding.scope_limit: Proposal specification review only; the proposed check was not executed and no mathematical lane is closed.
